how_to_apply: Submit application in person at Police Headquarters, Gurugram.
Attach 4 passport size photos, educational certificates, service discharge certificate, original domicile certificate and medical fitness certificate.
Make sure it reaches by 23 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Gurugram Police Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. RO 1084/11/5467/2027/50179/19/7 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download Gurugram Police notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Retired army personnel, former personnel of HSIF battalion and ex-personnel of Haryana Armed Police (HAP) Age limit: Between 25 years to 50 years Other conditions: Must be retired army personnel, HSIF or HAP ex-personnel

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Gurugram Police Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates removed from previous service due to indiscipline or medical grounds

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Rs. 20000 per month consolidated; Rs. 30 per month deducted for welfare fund. Appointed on temporary basis for a period of one year

content_sections.heading: How Will Gurugram Police Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Application submission Verification of documents Training No written test or physical measurement will be conducted for retired army personnel at the time of recruitment.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: 4 passport size photographs Educational certificates Service discharge certificate Original domicile certificate Medical fitness certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Gurugram Police Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Submit application in person at Police Headquarters, Gurugram. Attach 4 passport size photos, educational certificates, service discharge certificate, original domicile certificate and medical fitness certificate. Make sure it reaches by 23 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Rs. 30/- per month will be deducted from salary for welfare fund. Selected employees will be given 30 days casual leave in a year. Selected SPOs can be deployed in emergency in any district of Haryana state.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Gurugram Police Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Gurugram Police Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 33 vacancies for Special Police Officer (SPO).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Gurugram Police Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to Police Headquarters, Gurugram, by in person, to reach by 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is between 25 years to 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 20000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired army personnel, former personnel of HSIF battalion and ex-personnel of Haryana Armed Police (HAP).

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be retired army personnel, HSIF or HAP ex-personnel.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates removed from previous service due to indiscipline or medical grounds.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Application submission. Verification of documents. Training. No written test or physical measurement will be conducted for retired army personnel at the time of recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointed on temporary basis for a period of one year.
